svg.text: A143 — corner-first level-1 cover of k0_00: the BL intruder's cell (6 position x 6 position x 6 tilt = 216)
position grid over the corner-meeting zone [1/2, a_w + √2/2]^2 = [0.5000, 1.7326]^2, a_w = 1 + w = 1.025510 (Lemma K0-WIDEN); one panel per 15° tilt window.
GREEN = survives every geometric leaf (container clip, K' vs walls, K' lane test on all four corners). RED would be a geometry kill — there are none.
HATCHED = a Trump image's BL meeter lies in this cell (the canary: it can never be certified dead). x >= y is the D4_BL fundamental domain; cells below the diagonal are its transpose images.
Legend: cell colour = geometry verdict; dashed inner square = non-canonical (x < y) cell; diagonal line = the D4_BL mirror x = y (transpose, θ → 90° − θ).
Result: 0 of 216 cells die by geometry alone in the single-intruder root.
